text: Improve phase creation and deletion responsiveness; prevent duplicate phase creation on repeated Enter
description: User reports (2026-10-26): (1) After creating a phase, pressing Enter produced no visible UI response for several seconds. Pressing Enter again also appeared to do nothing; later, two phases appeared. Investigate the slow phase-creation path and provide immediate, clear pending feedback. Prevent duplicate phase creation when Enter is pressed again while the first creation is in flight (for example, guard/dedupe the submission). (2) Deleting a phase in list view is also very slow and takes several seconds. Investigate and improve phase deletion responsiveness in the list view as part of the same phase-operation performance scope.

status.comment: 2026-11-01 trace: modal → createAndSelectPhase → phase.create (writePhase + updateSiblingIds + search index) costs a few ms on this project; the backend is not the cause. Likely cause: the dev backend restarts under tsx watch on every backend/shared source change (agents edit those often). tRPC's default reconnect backoff (0, 2, 4, 8, 16 s) left the mutation queued for seconds, and the phase.create change event fell into the gap, so the new phase didn't show and a second Enter created another. 9c478c93: reconnect at 0/250/500 ms…2 s, the connection label shows 'connecting' while down, and a reconnect resyncs meta, phases and ideas (removing deleted ones). Not reproduced live; plausible match for 'nothing for seconds, then two phases'.
